name: Fugue of Delights
source:
A daemonic visual novel where your choices shape erotic dreams, secrets, and ritual desires.

You will traverse layers of myth, longing, and veiled memories — guided by Elylah, the princess of erotic dreams, in search of a muse long lost to the darkness.

This is not a story about conquest. It's about surrender.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3841380/]Steam[/url]]
